Price Rs. 16'50 INTRODUCTION The 'Statistical Abstract, Tripura—1962’ is the fourth issue in the series. Like the previous issues, the present issue fulfils the need of making available comprehensive and detailed information relating to important heads of economic and social developments. Data relating to the years 1954 to 1962 have been incorporated in the Abstract, except in few cases in which the figures relating to the earlier years were not available. Figures have been presented throughout in metric units of weights and measures. The various sections of the Abstract are preceded by brief explanatory notes which are intended to be read in conjunction with the tables. The primary sources of data are indicated at the foot ot each table. The Staiistical Department is gratefnl to the various Departments and Non-Government Organisations which have co-operated in bringing out this Abstract.
